name: GN — courbe → tube (Curve to Mesh)
description: Arbre GN : CurveLine + cercle profil → CurveToMesh → sortie. Paramétrique (longueur, rayon). Validé patterns Blender 4.0 interface API.

steps.code:
import bpy

LENGTH = {{length}}
RADIUS = {{profile_radius}}

def build(name='GN_PipeDemo'):
    if name in bpy.data.node_groups:
        bpy.data.node_groups.remove(bpy.data.node_groups[name])
    ng = bpy.data.node_groups.new(name, 'GeometryNodeTree')
    ng.is_modifier = True
    nodes, links = ng.nodes, ng.links
    nodes.clear()
    s_len = ng.interface.new_socket(name='Length', in_out='INPUT', socket_type='NodeSocketFloat')
    s_len.default_value = float(LENGTH)
    s_rad = ng.interface.new_socket(name='Radius', in_out='INPUT', socket_type='NodeSocketFloat')
    s_rad.default_value = float(RADIUS)
    ng.interface.new_socket(name='Geometry', in_out='INPUT', socket_type='NodeSocketGeometry')
    ng.interface.new_socket(name='Geometry', in_out='OUTPUT', socket_type='NodeSocketGeometry')
    n_in = nodes.new('NodeGroupInput'); n_in.location = (-700, 0)
    n_out = nodes.new('NodeGroupOutput'); n_out.location = (400, 0)
    line = nodes.new('GeometryNodeCurvePrimitiveLine'); line.location = (-400, 80)
    line.mode = 'POINTS'
    comb = nodes.new('ShaderNodeCombineXYZ'); comb.location = (-550, 80)
    links.new(n_in.outputs['Length'], comb.inputs['X'])
    links.new(comb.outputs['Vector'], line.inputs['End'])
    circle = nodes.new('GeometryNodeCurvePrimitiveCircle'); circle.location = (-400, -160)
    circle.mode = 'RADIUS'
    links.new(n_in.outputs['Radius'], circle.inputs['Radius'])
    c2m = nodes.new('GeometryNodeCurveToMesh'); c2m.location = (0, 0)
    c2m.inputs['Fill Caps'].default_value = True
    links.new(line.outputs['Curve'], c2m.inputs['Curve'])
    links.new(circle.outputs['Curve'], c2m.inputs['Profile Curve'])
    links.new(c2m.outputs['Mesh'], n_out.inputs['Geometry'])
    return ng

ng = build()
if 'GN_Pipe' in bpy.data.objects:
    obj = bpy.data.objects['GN_Pipe']
else:
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_plane_add(size=0.1, location=(0, 0, 0.5))
    obj = bpy.context.active_object
    obj.name = 'GN_Pipe'
mod = next((m for m in obj.modifiers if m.type == 'NODES'), None)
if mod is None:
    mod = obj.modifiers.new('GeometryNodes', 'NODES')
mod.node_group = ng
for item in ng.interface.items_tree:
    if getattr(item, 'in_out', None) != 'INPUT' or not hasattr(item, 'identifier'):
        continue
    if item.socket_type == 'NodeSocketGeometry':
        continue
    if item.name == 'Length':
        mod[item.identifier] = float(LENGTH)
    elif item.name == 'Radius':
        mod[item.identifier] = float(RADIUS)
bpy.context.view_layer.update()
eval_obj = obj.evaluated_get(bpy.context.evaluated_depsgraph_get())
result = {
    'ok': True,
    'object': obj.name,
    'tree': ng.name,
    'evaluated_verts': len(eval_obj.data.vertices),
    'evaluated_polygons': len(eval_obj.data.polygons),
}
